mainEntity.name: What should UCSB freshmen set up before classes start?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first quarter can feel overwhelming mostly because everything is new at once, but the learning curve gets much easier once your daily routine locks in.

mainEntity.name: Is UCSB hard for freshmen at first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freshmen usually need help with schedules, dining menus, campus events, and grade information. Lagoon bundles those workflows in one app.
